meta.title: System monitor
meta.description: Four progress bars under the composer show the CPU, memory, GPU and GPU-memory usage of the host running this session. Sampled in the DSH Host process, so a locally launched Harness and a remotely hosted one both report the server the session actually lives on. Supports Windows, macOS and Linux; NVIDIA, AMD and Apple GPUs. Click the bars to toggle the numbers; hover for exact values.
